[[Duke/Legends|Duke]] '''Teta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] resident of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The duke's [[Consort/Legends|consort]] was the scheming socialite [[Koyi Mateil/Legends|Koyi Mateil]], who planned to take his riches when he [[Death/Legends|died]]. He attended shows at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] on Coruscant near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], visiting in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] with Mateil during a performance of the ballet ''[[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]]''.

==Biography==
Teta was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duke/Legends|duke]]<ref name="CSWE" /> born around [[319 BBY/Legends|319 BBY]].<ref name="ChroniclesBirth" /> He resided on<ref name="CSWE" /> the Core Worlds [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Through elicit medication and gray-market organ transplants,<ref name="CSWE" /> he<ref name="CSWE2" /> was able to live to around 300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of age,<ref name="CSWE" /> far past the lifespan of a normal Human.<ref name="NEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Despite that, Teta made it a point to appear at public events with a beautiful companion.<ref name="CSWE" />

[[File:TetaKoyi-ROTS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Teta and Koyi Mateil visited the Galaxies Opera House.]]
Near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CSWE" /> between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems,<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> the duke attended shows at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]]<ref name="Chronicles" /> of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE" /> He was often in the of company<ref name="CSWE2" /> his consort,<ref name="DB2" /> [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] socialite [[Koyi Mateil/Legends|Koyi Mateil]], despite the differences in the two's ages. Mateil, however, was scheming to take Teta's riches should the duke [[Death/Legends|die]].<ref name="CSWE2" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the duke walked up the stairs of the Galaxies Opera House with Mateil during a performance of<ref name="Episode 3" /> the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] ballet ''[[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]]''.<ref name="SquidLake">{{CSWECite|III|185|''Squid Lake''}}</ref> While they did, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ran up the stairs past them to meet up with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] inside the house.<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The duke possessed light skin and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Equipment==
At the opera house, he wore [[Color/Legends|teal]] and mustard robes and a mustard [[Hat/Legends|hat]] with black detailing.<ref name="Dressing">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Teta first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="Episode 3" /> which released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Concept art of the character was drawn by artist [[Sang Jun Lee]].<ref name="ArtOf">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>  The opera steps scene that included Teta, who was portrayed by an uncredited extra,<ref name="Episode 3" /> was filmed at [[Shepperton Studios]] as part of additional photography on [[August 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> The character was first identified in the reference book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="Dressing" /> and released on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref>
